blocks.html: All new and replacement manufactured homes shall be prohibited in coastal high-hazard areas. Within A-Zones, all new, replaced or substantially improved manufactured homes shall be elevated such that the lowest floor of the manufactured home is elevated to or above the design flood elevation as specified in ASCE 24, Table 2-1.
